name: Offering
description:
You've participated in Madumarean rituals of sacrifice.

Once per rest, you may offer a sacrificial object to a body of water. Describe how the object is destroyed or rendered unusable. Increase the Difficulty by an amount equal to the cost, in Treasure, of the object.

At any time, you may spend a half action while near a body of water and reduce the Difficulty to call the water to your aid:

  • Reduce by 1 to make your first skill check made within the next minute favored.

  • Reduce by 5 to take +2d on your next skill check made within the next minute.

  • Reduce by 10 to gain 5 temporary Defense for the next minute.

  • Reduce by 15 to gain four temporary d4 engagement dice.

  • Reduce by 20 to regain Endurance equal to twice your BODY score.

Describe how you call the water to your aid.
